description: This Java source file defines the SDCardScannerService class, a JobIntentService subclass responsible for scanning removable external storage (like SD Cards) for F-Droid package repositories. It includes methods for initiating scans, checking external storage states, searching directories for specific repo files, and registering found repositories.

classes.name: SDCardScannerService
classes.description: A service class that scans external storage devices for F-Droid repositories, focusing on removable SD Cards, and registers found repositories.

methods.name: scan
methods.description: Static method to initiate a scan of external storage for repositories.

methods.name: onHandleWork
methods.description: Handles the intent to perform the storage scan, identifies removable storage, and searches directories for repo files.

methods.name: checkExternalStorage
methods.description: Checks if a given external storage directory is mounted and accessible, returning its files.

methods.name: searchDirectory
methods.description: Recursively searches a directory for repository files, skipping specified directories.

methods.name: registerRepo
methods.description: Registers a repository found at a specific file location.
